_comment: Copy to configs/billing_plans.json (or point BILLING_PLANS_FILE at it). Create each plan in Razorpay (Subscriptions > Plans) and each price in Stripe (Products), then paste their ids below. Charges come from Razorpay/Stripe; the amounts here are only what the Billing page shows, so keep them the same. 'limits' caps call minutes per month, AI agents and team members (leave a limit out for unlimited); the 'free' entry has no prices and sets the limits for workspaces without a paid plan. Every value below is a placeholder.
